object_description: A successor ARN local-vs-parent discriminator over the untouched confirmatory split, with distractor_similarity frozen as a blocking factor before execution and a representation ladder that includes non-lexical argument/event/role structure rather than only the lexical channel deliberately targeted by the distractor construction.
qoi: Whether recoverable source-grounded analogue signal persists within both pre-registered distractor-similarity strata under any registered representation, while holding the evaluator and observation contract fixed; only a valid failure across strata may challenge the parent abstraction.
assumptions: the confirmatory split was not used by discriminator v1
distractor_similarity is registered only as a blocking factor and is not candidate-visible
features may read only query_narrative and candidate narrative text
all representation families and combination rules are frozen before confirmatory outcomes

strongest_parents.justification: Immediate predecessor. Its aggregate lexical null was invalidated because opposite distractor-similarity strata cancelled, so v2 must register the blocking factor before outcome access.
Strongest executed local family; learned predicate-argument, vocabulary-masked and semantic controls all ended NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT.
Retained as a registered negative control: if non-lexical representations only reproduce the same opposite-signed surface pattern, the successor has not escaped the design artifact.

prior_art_equivalence_map: structure mapping under adversarial lexical distractors
oracle_or_lower_bound: Known-answer injected-signal fixtures within each registered distractor band prove that the scoring/permutation machinery can detect both lexical and non-lexical signal when present. Parent abstraction may be challenged only if every preregistered representation fails within each stratum and all positive-signal fixtures pass; an aggregate null alone is never sufficient.
minimal_counterexamples: aggregate chance with opposite within-band effects
one stratum recovers signal while another does not
non-lexical representation leaks correct_answer or distractor band
argument/event/role representation reproduces lexical anti-signal by construction
positive-signal fixture cannot pass the gate
one favourable stratum is selected only after outcomes
falsifier: The successor remains non-probative if positive-signal fixtures fail, if any representation leaks evaluator-only fields, or if registered strata still show cancellation/heterogeneity that the frozen rule cannot interpret. The parent abstraction is challenged only when all registered representations fail within both strata under a valid probe.
same_system_ablation: Same confirmatory rows/evaluator/permutation machinery with (a) lexical v1 features only and (b) each non-lexical representation family removed in turn.
hard_gate_obligations: distractor_similarity registered pre-outcome as blocking factor
distractor_similarity and correct_answer hidden from candidate features
no post-outcome stratum or representation selection
ancestor ascent remains blocked unless complete packet and valid discriminator support it
total_cost_equation: discriminator_total = representation_extraction + within_stratum_scoring + permutation_controls + positive_fixture_controls + validity_audit
novelty_residual: A pre-stratified, non-lexical successor that directly repairs the specific design artifact found by #729 while preserving the exact AncestorChallenge requirement instead of treating repeated failure as parent evidence.
permitted_publication_claim: Only a responsibility-localization claim under the frozen ARN observation/evaluator contract. No analogy-utility or scientific-authority claim; a negative valid discriminator may license an ancestor challenge but does not itself prove the parent false.
